messages:
Mina: photo drop! Socks the ferret discovered my slipper collection and claimed the fuzzy one. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F54321/socks_slipper.jpg :heart_eyes:

Owen: that slipper looks like it experienced a personality shift. ferret overlord energy :crown:

Priya: MUST KNOW 4A1 does Socks prefer the left or right slipper? This is critical for future laundry planning. :joy:

Mina: update: left slipper is the throne. right slipper was suspiciously shoved under the couch. :mag_right: sending a boop video later.

Kofi: vote: should we make a tiny scarf for Socks to match the slipper? 1) absolutely 2) danger to slipper aesthetics

Owen: `/:one:` absolutely. tiny scarf = new onboarding kit.

Priya: `/:two:` keep the slipper pure, avoid ferret fashion crimes.

SnackBot: Poll created: "Socks needs a slipper scarf?" Options: Absolutely / Keep slipper pure  Currently: Absolutely 1, Keep slipper pure 1

Mina: also discovered glitter on the slipper (where??) Socks sneezed and glitter came out. we may have a fairy ferret. :dizzy:

Owen: omg happy sneeze glitter. trademarking idea: Socks & Slipper Co. :moneybag:

Priya: convene craft night to knit tiny scarves and interrogate where glitter came from. whos in? :yarn:

Kofi: in, will bring emergency lint roller.

Mina: thanks friends, will post the boop vid and the crumb/glitter forensics later. good night ferret cult. :zzz:
